defects.source_says: EO 10979 (26 FR 11937, December 12, 1961) amended the order 'by substituting for section 2, 7, and 8 thereof the following', a new section 2(a)-(b). The claim's own judgment_reason and research_rationale say section 2 was restated and now differs in substance from its 1957 wording. defects.problem: internal inconsistency; wrong statement of what the current source prints for this clause

defects.claim_says: first end 1977-10-19 by EO 12014, because 'the held order [EO 10979] does not say that it ended this paragraph'
defects.source_says: EO 10979 substituted a new text for the whole of section 8, and that text contains no paragraphs (a) or (b). So paragraphs 8(a) and 8(b) were removed from the order on 1961-12-12. Their substance moved in modified form to the new 2(b) and the new section 8.
defects.problem: The earlier end, or the carry-forward, needs an analysis of the substitution. The reason given (the amending order does not name the paragraph) does not test a whole-section substitution, so the 1977 first-end date is not established.

The claim's clauses sec1-1-dup2 to sec1-4-dup2 say EO 13456 'replaced this paragraph' and that it ended on 2008-01-23. The restated EO 13456 text has no such responsibility.

defects.source_says: EO 13456 sec. 3(a) establishes the Committee 'as provided in the Act' and only refers to 'the chairperson'. For sec1-1 to sec1-4 the claim holds that such matters 'now rest on the statute, not on this clause' and ended on 2008-01-23. EO 13456 sec. 3(c)(ii) makes the CEA Chairman an observer, not a member.
defects.problem: The test is applied inconsistently across parallel membership and chair provisions, and the clause is marked operative even though its membership item was not carried forward as membership.
